papers.title_en: A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
papers.authors: Mads Toftrup, Marco Federici, Boris van Breugel, Paul Whatmough, Markus Nagel
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型低比特部署的Hessian引导训练后量化
papers.tldr: 低比特量化对LLM部署至关重要，但量化范围、线性变换与权重舍入常被分别优化，局部重构目标难以反映量化误差对下游预测的影响。本文推导联合权重与激活量化的Hessian引导输出变化近似，并基于可处理的Fisher近似构建统一PTQ框架，联合优化上述三类决策。方法在现代LLM上保持实用，在逐通道与分块量化中均稳定优于先进变换与舍入方法，为低比特量化提供统一敏感度目标。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects.   In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. Based on a tractable Fisher approximation, we formulate a unified post-training quantization framework that enables the joint optimization of quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective. The resulting method remains practical for modern large language models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods across both channel-wise and block-wise quantization settings.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuqi Li, Chuanyue Yan, Neil Rodrigues, Xianglong Wang, Xiaoqin Feng, Junming Liu, Xi Xiao, Zhongwei Cheng, Wei Li, Lin Chen, Yingli Tian
papers.evidence: 综述视频大模型免训练加速，涵盖token压缩与训练后量化并关注时空证据保留
papers.tldr: 视频大模型处理长视觉序列时计算、延迟与显存开销巨大。本综述聚焦免训练推理加速，按输入、视觉编码、投影器、预填充与解码五个干预阶段梳理方法，并将训练后量化作为跨阶段扩展单独讨论。文中分析干预位置如何影响证据保留与计算节省，指出局部效率提升未必带来端到端加速，并结合既有研究与统一评测实验给出精度-延迟权衡证据。
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.

papers.title_en: Don't Ask the LLM: Visual Token Pruning with Spectral Structure and Semantic Relevance
papers.authors: Intaek Shin, Geuntaek Lim, Sungjune Park, Yukyung Choi
papers.evidence: 在询问LLM之前进行查询感知的视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型将图像和视频表示为长视觉 token 序列，推理成本高。现有剪枝依赖的 CLS 注意力在强压缩下易偏向背景，而查询条件信号又需 LLM 大量计算后才可用。ST-Pruner 提出免训练的前置剪枝框架，融合与注意力无关的谱显著性和反转 patch-text 相似度。多模型上仅用最多 11.1% 视觉 token 保留超 95% 性能，LLaVA-NeXT 端到端加速 3.2 倍，为预 LLM 视觉 token 选择提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) represent images and videos as long visual-token sequences, substantially increasing inference costs. These costs motivate visual-token pruning, whose effectiveness depends on both what signal is used for selection and when that signal becomes available. Our analysis reveals complementary limitations: visual-side [CLS] attention produces scattered, background-biased selections under aggressive compression, while stronger query-conditioned signals become available after substantial computation within the large language model (LLM). This raises a natural question: can structurally coherent, query-aware token selection be performed before consulting the LLM? We therefore propose ST-Pruner (Spectral-Textual Pruner), a training-free framework for pre-LLM visual-token selection. It combines attention-independent spectral saliency with inverted patch-text similarity through parameter-free multiplicative fusion. Across diverse LVLMs, ST-Pruner retains over 95% of full-token performance using at most 11.1% of visual tokens and achieves a 3.2x end-to-end speedup on LLaVA-NeXT. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/ST-Pruner.

papers.title_en: Quantize by Doing: Task-Guided Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Jiuyi Xu, Xiao Hu, Meida Chen, Song Wang, Yang Ye, Yangming Shi
papers.evidence: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型的任务引导混合精度后训练量化
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型经训练后量化可降内存，但低比特下保持任务成功率仍难。现有方法多依赖校准数据的敏感度估计，直接用任务成功率指导混合精度分配仍欠缺。QbD-VLA利用短闭环评估的任务成功率分配权重与激活位宽，并考虑组件间精度交互。在四个VLA模型和四个LIBERO套件上，权重约4比特、激活低于6比特仍保持较强任务表现；真实机械臂上对X-VLA未检测到成功率损失，但对π0.5失效，提示部署前需实机评估。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but lowering bit widths while maintaining task performance remains challenging. Existing work has used sensitivity estimates from calibration data to assign bit widths to different model components. However, using task success directly to guide mixed-precision allocation is underexplored because closed-loop evaluations are costly and the effect of quantizing one component depends on the precision of other components. To this end, we propose \textbf{QbD-VLA}, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method that uses task success from short closed-loop evaluations to assign weight and activation bit widths while accounting for interactions between model components. Experiments covering four VLA models and all four LIBERO suites show strong task performance at average precisions of approximately 4 bits for weights and fewer than 6 bits for activations. On SIMPLER, the gain over uniform quantization is small. On a Franka Research 3 robot arm, simulation-selected allocations show no detected success-rate loss on X-VLA but fail on $π_{0.5}$. These findings support using task success to guide mixed-precision VLA quantization, while highlighting the need for real-world evaluation before deployment. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}{\texttt{github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}}.

papers.title_en: LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences
papers.authors: Neehal Tumma, Philipp Nazari, Rohan Cherukuri, Daniela Rus, T. Konstantin Rusch
papers.evidence: 利用功能不变性实现线性递归大模型低精度量化
papers.tldr: 线性递归模型成为softmax注意力的替代方案，但其低精度推理仍不成熟；预填充的chunkwise并行虽可转成稠密矩阵乘，直接量化却易失稳。LinQuant提出七类保持全精度计算的功能不变性，如旋转、对角缩放和衰减/写入因子重排，使操作数更易量化。作者推导其在线性、门控和delta-rule更新中的适用条件，并将其接入Mamba-2低精度预填充管线SSDi8。在Mamba-2 1.3B/2.7B/8B和Nemotron-H 8B上，匹配延迟下困惑度改善，验证了不变性量化的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

papers.title_en: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
papers.authors: Jiacheng Liu, Yaxin Luo, Xiaohan Zhao, Peng Sun, Xinyi Shang, Jiacheng Cui, Yonina C. Eldar, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.evidence: 对大模型逐层嵌入的极致向量量化压缩
papers.tldr: 随着Transformer扩展嵌入容量，逐层嵌入PLE在Gemma 4 E4B中已占35.2%参数，使极端压缩成为迫切需求。传统量化给每个token-layer向量分配独立短码，在超高压缩率下性能损失严重。OPTIC改为每个token只存一组共享量化码，并在各层用层特定仿射解码器还原，且让码与解码器拟合PLE输出路径而非原始存储向量。BF16 E4B约100倍PLE压缩时，OPTIC在七项基准平均保留97.8%性能，乘积量化仅66.3%；594倍和1002倍下仍保留90.5%和84.1%。约100倍压缩推理时显存降低29.7%，至多慢0.40%。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling embedding capacity alongside Transformer computation is an emerging trend in language models. This trend makes high compression rates increasingly useful. Hence, we study extreme compression of Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), which follow this trend and account for 35.2% of the parameters of Gemma 4 E4B. At such rates, conventional quantizers give each token-layer vector its own code of only a few bytes. We instead develop OPTIC (Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes), which stores one quantized code tuple per token and decodes it at every layer with a layer-specific affine decoder. Codes and decoders are fitted to the PLE output path rather than to the stored vectors. At about $100\times$ PLE compression of bfloat16 (BF16) E4B, OPTIC retains an aggregate 97.8% of the uncompressed model's performance across seven benchmarks, whereas product quantization, the strongest of six conventional baselines, retains 66.3%. At $594\times$ and $1,002\times$ PLE compression of BF16 E4B, OPTIC retains 90.5% and 84.1%. On the official E4B release with 4-bit linear weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16), OPTIC retains 96.9% at about $100\times$ PLE compression. During inference at about $100\times$ PLE compression, BF16 E4B uses 29.7% less GPU memory than with uncompressed PLE at the same key-value cache size, while running at most 0.40% slower.

papers.title_en: Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness
papers.authors: Zeyu Wang, Yiheng Duan, Tao Chen, Donghyun Koo, Sihan Liu, Wenbo Zhang, Chuan He, Liang Liu
papers.evidence: 面向高效低精度量化训练的结构化随机舍入
papers.tldr: 低精度训练常用随机舍入保持梯度无偏，但标准方法为每个梯度元素独立生成随机阈值，会占满加速器向量单元，使INT8训练甚至慢于BF16。为此，S3R在每个token的隐藏维共享一个随机阈值，并让上游梯度只量化一次，供激活梯度与权重梯度矩阵乘复用；S3R-EC再从两类梯度中减去结构化平均舍入误差。LLM预训练中，未校正的阈值共享会损害收敛，而S3R-EC消除该退化，验证损失匹配独立随机舍入，并在TPU v5p上把稠密LLM全INT8训练加速1.24–1.32倍。
papers.abstract_en: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

papers.title_en: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.authors: Jialv Zou, Xiaotong Li, Zhengrong Yue, Xu Huang, Yaxin Luo, Wenhao Yan, Haodong Li, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
papers.evidence: 分析离散视觉token的量化误差与有效比特预算对语义保真度的影响
papers.tldr: 离散视觉token常被认为因量化误差导致语义损失，连续表示被视为上限。作者以多模态理解为代理，发现有效比特预算比量化误差更关键，并提出Factorized Vector Quantization，用对称并行码本量化互补固定维视图。工业级数据训练后，该模型在离散表示模型中达SOTA，九指标均值超UniAR和Emu3-Chat 22.8%和59.2%，并首次在细粒度OCR等任务上与强连续模型Qwen3-VL竞争。结果表明离散视觉表示可支撑大规模原生多模态基础模型。
papers.abstract_en: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ

papers.title_en: ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Manish Das, Shiv Ram Dubey, Satish Kumar Singh
papers.evidence: 通过卷积路由剪除冗余视觉块令牌
papers.tldr: Vision Transformer 的自注意力随 token 数二次增长，且各层对所有 patch token 同等处理，带来冗余计算。ConvRoute-ViT 提出卷积式 token 路由：按类 token 注意力保留关键 patch，并将其余 token 空间重组压缩为卷积摘要 token。该方法在 CIFAR-100 和 TinyImageNet 上保持分类精度并提升计算效率。其意义在于以分层路由构建紧凑判别表征，为高效 ViT 提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

papers.title_en: Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs
papers.authors: Zimeng Wu, Qijian Tian, Penghui Du, Changqian Yu, Jiaxin Chen, Yunhong Wang
papers.evidence: 面向多模态模型的无训练注意力视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: 统一多模态模型的多图合成受长视觉上下文拖累，现有token剪枝多沿用理解任务，参考图探索不足且条件引导混乱。CATP作为首个面向UMM生成的免训练上下文压缩方法，用GCP同步条件分支剪枝，并以TCAM校正池化偏差。实验在多个UMM和基准上稳定优于SOTA，注意力核心最高加速2.09倍。它为多图生成提供质量与效率更优的即插即用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.
